experience.title: Software Engineer, Frontend and Mobile
description: Built the full frontend of De Mantelzorg App, a cross-platform app for informal caregivers (40+ screens; React Native, Expo, TypeScript), live on both app stores with 10+ municipality and care-organisation partners such as Almere, Emmen and Assen. Winner of the Audience Award, Nationale Zorginnovatieprijs 2024 (awarded to Valtes)
Worked on all 20+ releases since December 2025 in a two-developer team using sprints, daily standups, Jira, code reviews and CI/CD
Built the full frontend of Buurtalarm, a community alarm app live on both stores, with push notifications, alerts to nearby residents and map directions
Customised a Next.js dashboard template as part of a team, working on events and articles management connected to a Strapi CMS, so municipalities can manage their content and branding
Designed the UI in Figma and built it for older users: high-contrast colours, WCAG 2.1 guidelines and testing with screen readers
Wrote unit tests (Jest) and end-to-end tests with Playwright (web) and Maestro (mobile); managed app state with Redux, Zustand and TanStack Query
Contributed to 4 further mobile apps and 3 web projects (UI components, UX improvements, bug fixes)
Used AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) to speed up development, and reviewed and tested all generated code before release
